crossCuttingFindings.implication: There is no portable 'seat correction'. A harness must carry its own mirror control on its own map, or must alternate seats an equal number of times per side.

crossCuttingFindings.finding: Alternating seats centres the null at 50% only when the seat effect is independent of the policy occupying it; it does not remove seat VARIANCE.
